katy: Drafting a tailored manager/HR checklist for Max (ML infra) starting next week. This one has a couple extra steps for data access, sandbox, and eval infra. Please review and add role owners.

ryan: Thanks Kat. I'll set the Day 1 1:1 and pick a buddy. For this hire I want clear first-week deliverable: run an end-to-end eval and submit a reproducible PR that runs the pipeline.

katy: PASTE (for managers) - ML/Inference-focused checklist:
```
Pre-start (48-72h):
- IT: laptop + GPU passthrough config (if needed) or loaner reserved.
- Accounts: Slack, SSO, Git, CI service, cloud project access requested.
- DevEx: repo invites to `git.internal/redwood/models` and `git.internal/redwood/evals`.
- Security: sign-off on data access flow + NDA if customer traces are used.
- Manager: starter eval task + acceptance criteria ready (small reproducible run).

Day 1:
- 09:00 welcome (People Ops) + paperwork + benefits quick brief.
- 10:00 infra walkthrough (DevEx) - run a demo eval and show logs.
- 11:00 team intros + architecture map (15m each).
- Lunch with buddy.
- 14:00 starter task assigned: run eval with provided small dataset, open PR with reproducible command + README.
- 16:30 EOD 30m 1:1 (manager) to confirm acceptance criteria and 30/60/90 draft.

Week 1 goals:
- Replicate baseline eval locally and in CI (green run).
- Submit first PR that includes a minimal reproducer and CI test.
- Meet SRE and Security for deployment constraints and data handling.
- Draft 30/60/90 with measurable metrics (latency, p99 token cost, eval score).

30/60/90 (example metrics):
- 30d: run local + CI eval, merge 1 reproducible PR, complete sandbox access workflow.
- 60d: improve baseline inference latency or memory usage by X% on a measurable workload; add automated regression test.
- 90d: own an inference optimization ticket, ship change to staging, and present results in a cross-team demo.
``
Owners: People Ops (paperwork), IT (hardware & cloud quotas), DevEx (repos + CI), Manager (starter task + mentor), Security (data access & NDA).

ryan: I'll own the starter eval and acceptance criteria. @lee will be the buddy. @it-bot please confirm GPU loaner or cloud project before EOD Thursday.

it-bot: IT ticket #20077 created for max.ml  - GPU passthrough check + standard laptop + SSO. ETA: 2 business days.

max.ml: Quick Q - who approves access to customer traces (they're labeled PII-ish)? I need a tiny sample for the starter eval.

sandra (Security): @max.ml For customer traces we require manager approval, signed NDA, and a scoped access token with TTL. Use https://internal.redwood.dev/sec/access-request and include the exact files you need. We'll white-list a 24-hour token for bootstrapping.

max.ml: Great, thanks. Also, is there an internal library for standardized eval scripts?

devex: Yes: `git.internal/redwood/eval-scripts` and onboarding README at https://internal.redwood.dev/devex/ml-onboard. I'll add you and provide a sample `eval.yaml` and devcontainer. If hardware delayed, you can run a cloud dev VM image we pre-bake.

lee (Buddy): Mentor checklist (short): day 1 walkthrough, be available 1hr/day Week 1 for pairing, review starter PR within 24h, show team rituals + slack channels. I will schedule 1:1 pairing slots.

ryan: For 30/60/90 I'll make the metrics concrete in the Day 1 sync: e.g., 30d = run baseline eval in CI with <5% variance, merge reproducible PR; 60d = reduce inference latency by 10% on sample workload; 90d = own rollout to staging.

max.ml: One more: who can grant extended cloud quota if my experiments need temporary CPU/GPU?

it-bot: Cloud quota request #CQ-477 filed. Manager approval required; provisioning ETA depends on quota size. For small experiments we recommend using the dev GPU pool (contact DevEx).

katy: I'll update the master ML onboarding template with these specifics and send final invites once IT marks the ticket done. Please add any infra-specific checklist items now. :thumbsup:

eng-mgr: Add note: schedule 2-week checkpoint + 6-week review in calendar; include concrete acceptance checkboxes in the 1:1.

max.ml: Thanks everyone, this is super helpful. Looking forward to the starter task. :rocket:
